title: Evolving Popular Media: Nigerian Video Films
version: Research in African Literatures 29(3), pp. 106–128 (Fall 1998), coauthor-hosted copy.
lineage: Coauthor-hosted copy of the journal article. Haynes also authored the later accounts, so the equipment and budget details are treated as one evidentiary lineage.

passages.note: The account identifies Nnebue as an electronics dealer and film promoter and names Sola Ogunsola. 'A few VCRs' is less specific than Haynes's 2011 reprint. The personal communication citation follows the investment and returns claims.
